bio.text: Farley A. Santos represents Danbury's 109th District in the Connecticut House of Representatives.
He attended Danbury's public schools and graduated from Henry Abbott Technical High School.
He was first elected to the Danbury City Council, representing the 4th Ward, in 2019, and previously served on the Danbury Board of Education.
He worked nearly 16 years at Savings Bank of Danbury and serves as Economic and Community Development Advisor to Mayor Roberto Alves; he lives in Danbury with his wife and daughter.
